opening.argument: The central account is a personal food-and-travel vlog: the speaker says they redeemed their own rewards for a free medium two-topping pizza, discusses eating it, and talks about revisiting a barbecue restaurant while traveling. Those are descriptions of the speaker's plans and experience, not a pitch built around the pizza reward. The Mercari and Uber offers appear separately as promotions for a first-purchase discount and a ride discount. Nothing in the supplied account describes deceptive conditions, credential collection, or a connection between those offers and the pizza discussion. The record supports the narrower conclusion that these are separate promotions alongside a personal vlog, without establishing any deceptive outcome.

citations.quote: I decided to get some pizza and I have a free pizza that I can redeem. So I ended up redeeming it for a free medium two topping pizza with my rewards.
And then I want to go visit the barbecue restaurant that I went to a few times when I was in that area of the country a few years ago.
Use my code "GGFPPB" to join Mercari and get $2 off your first purchase!
You just earned a FREE ride to try Uber (worth up to $15)! Plus, rides are now up to 25 percent off for a limited time.
